findings.finding: Empirical difficulty for frontier models is unmeasured. Oracle, mutated and transformed controls are deterministic author/reviewer programs, not model attempts. Historical Gemini trials were infrastructure interrupted and supply zero verified graded successes, not scientific failures.
findings.required_correction: None for honest local package QC; obtain separately authorized valid model trials before claiming empirical frontier difficulty.

findings.finding: Originality is supported only against the pinned 97-instruction corpus and a limited saved code reference. It is not a web-wide plagiarism or mathematical-novelty proof.
findings.required_correction: Retain this limitation in any originality claim.

findings.finding: The reference frame search has an algebraically complete finite fallback but exponentially large worst-case search space. Measured native shipped-family solvability is strong; a universal 180-second runtime guarantee is not established.
findings.required_correction: Do not generalize observed resource margins into a worst-case complexity claim.

findings.finding: CTRF reports 12 four-case batches. A failed batch stops at its first failing pencil; per-pencil discrimination is therefore established by separate author/reviewer computations, not native CTRF alone. Numerical rank alone is correct on all 48 and provides no discrimination evidence.
findings.required_correction: Continue reporting batch-native and per-pencil evidence separately.

findings.finding: This is one fresh-context AI reviewer opinion, not independent human domain review, a two-vote panel, an external QC service approval, publication readiness certification or frontier-model approval.
findings.required_correction: Describe the result as independent local QC, with its scope.
